title: A8 muscle-memory migration: preserve, alias, deprecate, or remove every live command-surface name
question: Design the migration from today's command surface (slash commands, skills, monitors, ad-hoc scripts) to the product surface WITHOUT breaking the owner's muscle memory: which names are preserved, which are aliased, which are deprecated with a warning period, and what usage evidence must be observed before a deprecated name is actually removed.

worktree_census.removal_rule: A name may move from deprecated to removed only after (a) two product releases and (b) zero observed invocations in a 14-day window, with a successor already preserved or aliased. Names already at zero usage and never on the product surface are removed now; their successors are recorded.
worktree_census.why_none_removed: This worktree has no 14-day usage ledger for the live command/skill trees, so no live name is deprecated or removed. The fixtures/live + usage-ledger.jsonl surface is the closed proof that the removal rule fires only at zero-in-window.

source_layout.notes: C:/Users/Prekzursil live trees and ~/.claude are absent on this Linux worktree. Totality and alias round-trip are proved on the closed fixtures/live tree (invocable). commands/ and .agents/skills/ were walked with pathlib for the worktree census; names were not recalled from memory.

mapping.to: alias or deprecate onto a product surface

enumeration.method: pathlib walk of fixtures/live/{commands,skills,monitors,scripts}; slash names from markdown frontmatter, skills from SKILL.md frontmatter, monitors from JSON name, scripts from '# name:' header

removal.rule: A name may move from deprecated to removed only after (a) two product releases and (b) zero observed invocations in a 14-day window, with a successor already preserved or aliased. Names already at zero usage and never on the product surface are removed now; their successors are recorded.

evidence.notes: Enumerated 21 names from disk. Product names ['/run', '/cockpit', '/catalog', 'skill.catalog']. Usage is jsonl event counts in the 14-day window ending 2026-08-24, not estimated. Product surfaces are /run /cockpit /catalog (ARC-0052 one-command / one-cockpit / one-catalog). Worktree census: 71 commands, 347 skills.

retry.policy: re-measure once with a MECHANICALLY DIFFERENT probe (different shell, different data field); if the two readings disagree report BLOCKED with both numbers rather than picking one

scope.proof_surface: mechanical name walk of the ARC-0056 live fixture trees plus live invoke() of every aliased old name against those files. Not a claim that the Windows live estate was read.
does_not_claim: C:/Users/Prekzursil live trees were read on this host

reviewer.notes: Probe1 recomputes the four-way partition from a directory walk and the ledger counts. Probe2 live-invokes each aliased name (resolved target string, a different field) and refuses NOT-FOUND / REMOVED. Catalog scoring by a second human migration engineer is independent of G-1 probe-green.
